messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Interlingua, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Interlingua line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
In medio del cammino de nostre vita io trovava me in una selva obscur, pro le via recte esseva perdite.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word/Phrase | Back‑Translation (Eng.) | Status | |-------------|-----------------------|--------------------|--------------------------|--------| | Nel | “in the” (locative) | **In** | in | OK | | mezzo | “middle, midpoint” | **medio** | middle | OK | | del | “of the” (genitive) | **del** | of the | OK | | cammin | “journey, road” (archaic) | **cammino** | road/journey | OK | | di | “of” (genitive) | **de** | of | OK | | nostra | “our” (possessive) | **nostre** | our | OK | | vita | “life” | **vita** | life | OK | | mi | reflexive “myself” | **me** | myself | OK | | ritrovai | “found (past)” | **trovava** | was finding / found (imperfect) | **WRONG** (tense does not match the simple past) | | per | “through, within” | **in** | in/within | OK | | una | indefinite article “a” | **una** | a | OK | | selva | “forest, wood” | **selva** | forest | OK | | oscura | “dark” | **obscur** | dark | OK | | ché | “because, for” (causal) | **pro** | for | OK | | la | definite article “the” (fem.) | **le** | the | OK | | diritta | “right, straight” (adj.) | **recte** | straight/right (adverbial use) | OK | | via | “way, path” | **via** | way | OK | | era | “was” (imperfect of *essere*) | **esseva** | was (imperfect) | OK | | smarrita | “lost, missed” | **perdite** | lost/missed | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention - **WRONG:** *ritrovai → trovava* – the Interlingua verb is in the imperfect (“was finding”) rather than the simple past required for “found”. - No **MISSING**, **GRAMMAR**, or **UNNECESSARY** items were identified.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Interlingua script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Interlingua text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 1: - Original: **In medio del cammino de nostre vita** - Issue: none - Corrected: **no change**
- Line 2: - Original: **io trovava me in una selva obscur,** - Issue: **WRONG** (reflexive pronoun order) & **GRAMMAR** (adjective form) - Corrected: **io me trovava in una selva obscure,**
- Line 3: - Original: **pro le via recte esseva perdite.** - Issue: **GRAMMAR** (past‑participle gender/number) - Corrected: **pro le via recte esseva perdita.**
```interlingua In medio del cammino de nostre vita io me trovava in una selva obscure, pro le via recte esseva perdita. ```
